properties.rationale: Approved for build by Anthony on 2026-07-30 but not yet built, so there is nothing to verify. The capability is `planned` and its verification will be written with it. This is deliberately NOT a judgement that the capability needs no check — it needs one, and the check is owed at build time. Recorded so the open list keeps meaning `needs a decision` rather than `needs typing`; the decision here has been made and it is `build it`. NOTE THE EXPIRY THIS DEPENDS ON: this acknowledgement should stop holding the moment the capability moves off `planned`, and the sibling requirement req:review-expires-when-what-it-judged-changes exists precisely because that expiry is currently keyed on the affected node SET rather than its CONTENT — so this note may outlive its own truth until cap:review-expires-on-content is built.
